newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil reverses early trend, ends higher.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil reverses early trend, ends higher.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Ended higher on results of an Egyptian tender and shortcovering at the lower level. Prices fell at the open on follow-through selling after Wednesday's plunge on the domestic and Chicago soyoil markets. Near-term trading seen at a range of 1,178-1,210.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Scattered with interest seen among nearby CPOs and RBD palm olein.
Dealers said they noted active selling on Thursday until results of the Egyptian tender emerged in late trading.
Egypt bought 10,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil at $534.20 a tonne c and f and 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin at $404 a tonne c and f for July arrival, European vegetable oil dealers said.
Trading closed with a turnover of 2,121 lots.
The August third-month futures contract was expected to test a support level of 1,178 and resistance of 1,210 in the near term, said local dealers.
At the close, the August contract rose six ringgit to 1,198 ringgit ($476.15) a tonne after falling to 1,180.

Physicals June (south) saw offers at 1,237.50 ringgit against bids of 1,230 after trading at 1,225 and 1,230. June (central) was offered at 1,230 against bids of 1,225 and trades of 1,217.50 and 1,225.
July (south) saw offers at 1,235 after bidding at 1,230 and trading at 1,215 and 1,227.50 .
July (central) was offered at 1,225 against bids of 1,217.50.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered at $520, July at $517.50 and Aug/Sept at $515. June was traded at $515.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $562.50, July at $560 and Aug/Sept at $552.50. July was traded at $550 and $554..
June/July RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $270.
